meta.name: Star Wars Episode II Attack of the Clones
meta.description: Following an assassination attempt on Senator Padmé Amidala, Jedi Knights Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi investigate a mysterious plot into the heart of the Separatist movement and the beginning of the Clone Wars.
meta.slogan: A Jedi shall not know anger. Nor hatred. Nor love.
